monitoringSet.statement: Curated Arizona monitoring set; not the total number of groundwater basins recognized by ADWR.

dataPolicy.statement: Official ADWR geometry is used transiently for validation and spatial joins. The snapshot stores only derived centers and aggregate site counts. Displayed numeric observations come from USGS.

sources.title: Groundwater Basin 2025
sources.use: Official names, classifications, geometry validation, and spatial joins

sources.title: Groundwater Site Inventory telemetry layer
sources.use: Aggregate monitoring-site coverage only; raw records are not stored

sources.title: Groundwater field measurements since 2010-01-01
sources.use: Single-well historical series; never aggregated as a basin trend

latestObservation.meaning: Depth below land surface at one monitoring well; not a basin-wide average

representativeSeries.selectionMethod: USGS site with the most static or unqualified field measurements in this basin since 2010; not a basin-wide average
